defects.description: A rejected handler is swallowed, so the caller receives no error carrying the failed item's context.

trigger.input: node --input-type=module -e 'import { runPipeline } from "./src/pipeline.js"; try { await runPipeline([{ id: "bad" }], async () => { throw new Error("offline"); }); console.log("resolved"); } catch (error) { console.log(JSON.stringify({ name: error.name, message: error.message, itemId: error.itemId })); }'

defects.why_missed: The suite's handlers resolve successfully, so its happy path never exercises error propagation.

traps.description: A timed-out item is logged and skipped instead of failing the batch, as the documented trade-off requires.
